messages:
maia: Postmortem follow-up: short list of owners for vendor/dependency outage mitigations (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). Need owners + ETA.

maia: Proposed actions: 1) registry auth fallback shim + feature flag, 2) cloud retry/backoff + transient circuit, 3) lightweight registry canary + fallback metric, 4) monthly vendor SLA review + Quarterly drill.

hugo: I'll take #2 (cloud backoff + circuit). Plan: conservative backoff, add failure-count detector to flip to fallback. Staging rollout next Tue.

anya: I'll own #1 (fallback shim). Will add REGISTRY_FALLBACK_MODE=read-cache, a short TTL-stretch hint for clients (~2m), and integration tests. Target PR by Friday.

maia: @anya please include a hazard note about token-stretch behavior so clients don't overload auth.

anya: noted, will add. Also adding a feature-flag `registry_fallback_canary` so we can canary roll.

hugo: for #3 I'll coordinate with monitoring to add a 5m canary job that emits latency/p99 and a `registry_fallback` event when engaged. Prototype by end of week.

maia: also setting a 15m on-call ack SLA for vendor-auth regressions; @hugo please update PD escalation.

hugo: ack, will update escalation policy and add a monthly vendor SLA review to Ops calendar.

sre-bot: reminder: create follow-up ticket "dep-outage-mitigation-2026Q2" assigned to maia, anya, hugo (due 2026-05-10).

maia: everyone, please add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri. I'll compile the tracker and report to leadership. Thanks.
